# stripe_metronome_account_bridge (Resource)

Activates the Stripe account for Metronome and waits for shared-key access. Destroy forgets state without revoking access.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `readiness_timeout` (String) Wait after activation for authorization caches to expire. Must be at least 5m30s.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `mode` (String)
- `stripe_account_id` (String)
